name: AGLS
description: Adds AGLS (Australian Government Locator Service) metadata tags to pages as Metatag plugins.

suggests.drupal/markdown: Makes the README.md display easier to read on the help page. Alternatively just read the file directly.

project_description: This module extends the Metatag module to add tags for the AGLS (Australian Government Locator Service) Metadata Standard, a set of descriptive properties and usage guidelines that improve the visibility, manageability and interoperability of online information and services. It ships a Metatag group ('agls') and a set of AGLSTERMS.* meta tag plugins (jurisdiction, availability, function, mandate, category, document type, protective marking, service type, and more), each configurable through Metatag's per-entity and default-tag configuration. It also emits the two schema.dcterms / schema.AGLSTERMS link elements the AGLS HTML5 profile requires. Metatag 2.0+ is required by all versions of this module, and AGLS 2.0.x requires PHP 8.0. Initial development was sponsored by the Australian Law Reform Commission and the Department of Families, Housing, Community Services and Indigenous Affairs.
